name: Monica Garcia
office: Glendora Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Monica Garcia is a trustee on the Glendora Unified School District Board of Education, first elected in 2022 with a term ending in December 2026. She serves as president of the San Gabriel Valley Regional Occupational Program Joint Board of Management. Her campaign states she has 14 years of involvement with Glendora schools as a parent, a PTA volunteer and a member of the Glendora Education Foundation.

sentences.text: Monica Garcia is a trustee on the Glendora Unified School District Board of Education, first elected in 2022 with a term ending in December 2026.
She serves as president of the San Gabriel Valley Regional Occupational Program Joint Board of Management.
Her campaign states she has 14 years of involvement with Glendora schools as a parent, a PTA volunteer and a member of the Glendora Education Foundation.

items.text: At a March 2025 board meeting, Garcia thanked speakers of all viewpoints regarding a state-mandated ethnic studies pilot course and asked the community to continue outreach; the board agreed to reconsider the item. She has completed certifications in fentanyl and naloxone training and the California Ethnic Studies Model Curriculum.
